title: Modelling protein complexes with crosslinking mass spectrometry and deep learning
authors: Stahl K; Demann L; Bremenkamp R; Warneke R; Hormes B; Stülke J; Brock O; Rappsilber J
one_liner_zh: 该文将交联质谱距离约束整合进AlphaFold-Multimer以改进蛋白复合物结构建模，虽非TF-DNA体系，但方法可迁移至蛋白质-DNA互作建模，属于广义蛋白复合物互作建模且有AI方法创新。
abstract: Scarcity of structural and evolutionary information on protein complexes poses a challenge to deep learning-based structure modelling. We integrated experimental distance restraints obtained by crosslinking mass spectrometry (MS) into AlphaFold-Multimer, by extending AlphaLink to protein complexes. Integrating crosslinking MS data substantially improves modelling performance on challenging targets, by helping to identify interfaces, focusing sampling, and improving model selection. This extends to single crosslinks from whole-cell crosslinking MS, opening the possibility of whole-cell structural investigations driven by experimental data. We demonstrate this by revealing the molecular basis of iron homeostasis in Bacillus subtilis .
abstract_zh: 蛋白质复合物结构和进化信息的稀缺对基于深度学习的结构建模构成了挑战。我们通过将交联质谱（MS）获得的实验距离约束整合到AlphaFold-Multimer中，扩展了AlphaLink以适用于蛋白质复合物。整合交联质谱数据显著提高了对挑战性靶标的建模性能，通过帮助识别界面、聚焦采样和改进模型选择。这扩展到来自全细胞交联质谱的单一交联，开启了由实验数据驱动的全细胞结构研究的可能性。我们通过揭示枯草芽孢杆菌中铁稳态的分子基础来证明这一点。
